passages.text: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
passages.sermon:
All the people of Israel had their names recorded.
Writers wrote these names in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
The tribe of Judah acted unfaithfully.
Because of this, the people of Judah went into exile in Babylon.
passages.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ וְהִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִיהוּדָ֛ה הָגְל֥וּ לְבָבֶ֖ל בְּמַעֲלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites, priests, Levites, and temple servants.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
The Israelites were the first to return to their own property.
They settled in their own cities.
The priests also returned first.
The Levites returned first as well.
The temple servants returned first too.
passages.original: וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְהַנְּתִינִֽים׃

passages.text: These were some of the descendants of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Some Israelites lived in Jerusalem.
These Israelites came from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh.
Uthai lived in Jerusalem.
Uthai was the son of Ammihud.
Ammihud was the son of Omri.
Omri was the son of Imri.
Imri was the son of Bani.
Bani was a descendant of Perez.
Perez was the son of Judah.
passages.original: וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ עוּתַ֨י בֶּן־ עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן־ עָמְרִי֙ בֶּן־ אִמְרִ֣י בֶן־ בָּנִימִן־ בְּנֵי־ פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
passages.sermon:
The Shilonites were a group from the tribe of Israel.
Asaiah was the firstborn among the Shilonites.
Asaiah had sons.
Asaiah and his sons belonged to the Shilonites.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַשִּׁ֣ילוֹנִ֔י עֲשָׂיָ֥ה הַבְּכ֖וֹר וּבָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: From the Zerahites: Jeuel and 690 relatives.
passages.sermon: The Zerahites were a family group in Israel.\r\nJeuel was a member of the Zerahites.\r\nJeuel had 690 relatives.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי־ זֶ֖רַח יְעוּאֵ֑ל וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃

passages.text: From the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah; Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah; and 956 of their relatives according to their genealogy. All these men were heads of their families.
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites were a tribe of Israel.
Sallu was a Benjamite.
Sallu was the son of Meshullam.
Meshullam was the son of Hodaviah.
Hodaviah was the son of Hassenuah.
Ibneiah was a Benjamite.
Ibneiah was the son of Jeroham.
Elah was a Benjamite.
Elah was the son of Uzzi.
Uzzi was the son of Michri.
Meshullam was a Benjamite.
Meshullam was the son of Shephatiah.
Shephatiah was the son of Reuel.
Reuel was the son of Ibnijah.
There were 956 relatives of these men.
These relatives were counted by their genealogy.
All these men were heads of their families.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֖י בִּנְיָמִ֑ן סַלּוּא֙ בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם בֶּן־ הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ הַסְּנֻאָֽה׃ וְיִבְנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֔ם וְאֵלָ֥ה בֶן־ עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן־ מִכְרִ֑י וּמְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־ שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ רְעוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ יִבְנִיָּֽה׃ וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ לְתֹ֣לְדוֹתָ֔ם תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin; Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the chief official of God’s temple; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer; and 1,760 of their relatives, the heads of their families, able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
passages.sermon:
The priests included Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin.
Azariah was a priest.
Azariah was the son of Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was the son of Meshullam.
Meshullam was the son of Zadok.
Zadok was the son of Meraioth.
Meraioth was the son of Ahitub.
Azariah was the chief official of God’s temple.
Adaiah was a priest.
Adaiah was the son of Jeroham.
Jeroham was the son of Pashhur.
Pashhur was the son of Malchijah.
Maasai was a priest.
Maasai was the son of Adiel.
Adiel was the son of Jahzerah.
Jahzerah was the son of Meshullam.
Meshullam was the son of Meshillemith.
Meshillemith was the son of Immer.
There were 1,760 of their relatives.
These men were heads of their families.
They were able men.
They worked in the service of the house of God.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה וִיהוֹיָרִ֖יב וְיָכִֽין׃ וַעֲזַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־ חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־ צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־ מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖יד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס וַעֲדָיָה֙ בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־ פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֨י בֶּן־ עֲדִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן־ יַחְזֵ֛רָה בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־ מְשִׁלֵּמִ֖ית בֶּן־ אִמֵּֽר׃ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a descendant of Merari; Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph; Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a special group in Israel.
They served God in the temple.
Shemaiah was a Levite.
Shemaiah was the son of Hasshub.
Hasshub was the son of Azrikam.
Azrikam was the son of Hashabiah.
Hashabiah was a descendant of Merari.
Bakbakkar was also a Levite.
Heresh was a Levite.
Galal was a Levite.
Mattaniah was a Levite.
Mattaniah was the son of Mica.
Mica was the son of Zichri.
Zichri was the son of Asaph.
Obadiah was a Levite.
Obadiah was the son of Shemaiah.
Shemaiah was the son of Galal.
Galal was the son of Jeduthun.
Berechiah was a Levite.
Berechiah was the son of Asa.
Asa was the son of Elkanah.
Berechiah lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
passages.original: וּמִֽן־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן־ חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־ עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃ וּבַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְגָלָ֑ל וּמַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ מִיכָ֔א בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן־ אָסָֽף׃ וְעֹבַדְיָה֙ בֶּֽן־ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־ יְדוּת֑וּן וּבֶרֶכְיָ֤ה בֶן־ אָסָא֙ בֶּן־ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַצְרֵ֥י נְטוֹפָתִֽי׃

passages.text: These were the gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives. Shallum was their chief; he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers were men from the Levites.
Their names were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, and Ahiman.
Their relatives also served as gatekeepers.
Shallum was the chief gatekeeper.
Shallum had been stationed at the King’s Gate.
The King’s Gate was on the east side.
These men served as gatekeepers for the camp of the Levites.
passages.original: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְעַקּ֔וּב וְטַלְמֹ֖ן וַאֲחִימָ֑ן וַאֲחִיהֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָרֹֽאשׁ׃ וְֽעַד־ הֵ֔נָּה בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִזְרָ֑חָה הֵ֚מָּה הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לְמַחֲנ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃

passages.text: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent, just as their fathers had been assigned to guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Shallum was a Levite.
He was the son of Kore.
Kore was the son of Ebiasaph.
Ebiasaph was the son of Korah.
Shallum had relatives from the Korahite family.
The Korahites were Levites.
Shallum and his Korahite relatives had a special duty.
They guarded the thresholds of the Tent.
Their fathers had the same duty before them.
Their fathers guarded the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.
passages.original: וְשַׁלּ֣וּם בֶּן־ ק֠וֹרֵא בֶּן־ אֶבְיָסָ֨ף בֶּן־ קֹ֜רַח וְֽאֶחָ֧יו לְבֵית־ אָבִ֣יו הַקָּרְחִ֗ים עַ֚ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הָעֲבוֹדָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסִּפִּ֖ים לָאֹ֑הֶל וַאֲבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ עַל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַמָּבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.
passages.sermon: Phinehas was the son of Eleazar.\r\nPhinehas had authority over the gatekeepers in earlier times.\r\nThe LORD was with Phinehas.
passages.original: וּפִֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֗ר נָגִ֨יד הָיָ֧ה עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְפָנִ֖ים יְהוָ֥ה׀ עִמּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was the son of Meshelemiah.
Zechariah served as a gatekeeper.
He guarded the entrance.
The entrance was to the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting was the house of the LORD.
passages.original: זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּ֣ן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֔ה שֹׁעֵ֥ר פֶּ֖תַח לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
Samuel was a prophet and seer.
David and Samuel chose men to be gatekeepers.
These men guarded the thresholds.
There were 212 gatekeepers.
They registered these men by genealogy.
They recorded their family lines in their villages.
David and Samuel appointed these men.
They gave them positions of trust.
passages.original: כֻּלָּ֤ם הַבְּרוּרִים֙ לְשֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּסִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹאֶ֖ה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם׃

passages.text: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD—the house called the Tent.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers served at the house of the LORD.
The house of the LORD was also called the Tent.
The gatekeepers’ descendants also served as gatekeepers.
They guarded the gates.
They watched over the house of the LORD.
They kept their assigned duties.
passages.original: וְהֵ֨ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־ הַשְּׁעָרִ֧ים לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֛ה לְבֵ֥ית־ הָאֹ֖הֶל לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers stood at the gates of the house of the LORD.
They guarded four sides of the house.
They stood on the east side.
They stood on the west side.
They stood on the north side.
They stood on the south side.
passages.original: לְאַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֔וֹת יִהְי֖וּ הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים מִזְרָ֥ח יָ֖מָּה צָפ֥וֹנָה וָנֶֽגְבָּה׃

passages.text: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.
passages.sermon:
The gatekeepers served at the house of the LORD.
Their relatives lived in villages.
These relatives traveled from their villages at set times.
They came to help the gatekeepers.
They served together for seven days each time.
passages.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֨ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֨וֹא לְשִׁבְעַ֧ת הַיָּמִ֛ים מֵעֵ֥ת אֶל־ עֵ֖ת עִם־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: But the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the rooms and the treasuries of the house of God.
passages.sermon:
The four chief gatekeepers were Levites.
They served faithfully.
They had responsibility for the rooms of the house of God.
They also managed the treasuries of the house of God.
passages.original: כִּ֣י בֶאֱמוּנָ֞ה הֵ֗מָּה אַרְבַּ֙עַת֙ גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֔ים הֵ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־ הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל הָאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they were responsible for guarding it and opening it every morning.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were chief gatekeepers.
They stayed around the house of God at night.
They guarded the house of God.
They had the keys to the house of God.
They opened the house of God every morning.
passages.original: וּסְבִיב֥וֹת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וְהֵ֥ם עַל־ הַמַּפְתֵּ֖חַ וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר לַבֹּֽקֶר׃

passages.text: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship, to count them whenever they were brought in or taken out.
passages.sermon:
Some Levites had a special job.
They watched over the articles used in worship.
They counted each article when someone brought it in.
They counted each article when someone took it out.
passages.original: וּמֵהֶ֖ם עַל־ כְּלֵ֣י הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה כִּֽי־ בְמִסְפָּ֣ר יְבִיא֔וּם וּבְמִסְפָּ֖ר יוֹצִיאֽוּם׃

passages.text: Others were put in charge of the furnishings and other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense, and spices.
passages.sermon:
Some men had special duties in the house of God.
They took care of the furnishings.
They watched over all the holy articles.
They managed the fine flour.
They managed the wine.
They managed the oil.
They managed the frankincense.
They managed the spices.
passages.original: וּמֵהֶ֗ם מְמֻנִּים֙ עַל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְעַל־ הַסֹּ֙לֶת֙ וְהַיַּ֣יִן וְהַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְהַלְּבוֹנָ֖ה וְהַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃

passages.text: And some of the sons of the priests mixed the spices.
passages.sermon: Some of the sons of the priests had a special job.\r\nThey mixed the spices.\r\nThey prepared the spices for use in worship.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים רֹקְחֵ֥י הַמִּרְקַ֖חַת לַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃

passages.text: A Levite named Mattithiah, the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite, was entrusted with baking the bread.
passages.sermon:
Mattithiah was a Levite.
He was the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite.
The leaders entrusted Mattithiah with baking the bread.
He carried out this responsibility faithfully.
passages.original: וּמַתִּתְיָה֙ מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם ה֥וּא הַבְּכ֖וֹר לְשַׁלֻּ֣ם הַקָּרְחִ֑י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֕ה עַ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַחֲבִתִּֽים׃

passages.text: Some of their Kohathite brothers were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were a group among the Levites.
Some of the Kohathite brothers had a special duty.
They prepared the rows of the showbread.
They did this work every Sabbath.
passages.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֧י הַקְּהָתִ֛י מִן־ אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ לֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת לְהָכִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּֽת׃ס

passages.text: Those who were musicians, the heads of Levite families, stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night.
passages.sermon:
The musicians were Levites.
They were heads of their families.
They stayed in the temple chambers.
They did not have other duties.
They were responsible for their work day and night.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַ֠מְשֹׁרְרִים רָאשֵׁ֨י אָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם בַּלְּשָׁכֹ֖ת פְּטִירִים כִּֽי־ יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֛יְלָה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃

passages.text: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon: These men were leaders of Levite families.\r\nThey were chiefs according to their family records.\r\nThey lived in Jerusalem.
passages.original: אֵלֶּה֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah.
passages.sermon: Jeiel was the father of Gibeon.\r\nJeiel lived in Gibeon.\r\nJeiel’s wife was named Maacah.
passages.original: וּבְגִבְע֛וֹן יָשְׁב֥וּ אֲבִֽי־ גִבְע֖וֹן יְעוּאֵל וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃

passages.text: Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
passages.sermon:
Jeiel was the father of Gibeon.
Jeiel lived in Gibeon.
Jeiel’s wife was Maacah.
Jeiel’s firstborn son was Abdon.
Jeiel’s other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.
passages.original: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֣וּר וְקִ֔ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנֵ֖ר וְנָדָֽב׃ וּגְד֣וֹר וְאַחְי֔וֹ וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה וּמִקְלֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
passages.sermon: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam.\r\nShimeam and his family lived in Jerusalem.\r\nThey lived there with their relatives.
passages.original: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שִׁמְאָ֑ם וְאַף־ הֵ֗ם נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
passages.sermon:
Ner was the father of Kish.
Kish was the father of Saul.
Saul was the father of Jonathan.
Saul was the father of Malchishua.
Saul was the father of Abinadab.
Saul was the father of Esh-baal.
passages.original: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־ יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־ מַלְכִּי־ שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־ אֲבִינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־ אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃

passages.text: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, who was the father of Micah.
passages.sermon: Jonathan had a son.\r\nHis son was Merib-baal.\r\nMerib-baal was the father of Micah.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִי־ בַ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מִיכָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
passages.sermon: Micah was a man in the genealogy of Saul’s family.\r\nMicah had sons.\r\nHis sons were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַחְרֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: Ahaz was the father of Jarah; Jarah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.
passages.sermon:
Ahaz was the father of Jarah.
Jarah was the father of Alemeth.
Jarah was the father of Azmaveth.
Jarah was the father of Zimri.
Zimri was the father of Moza.
passages.original: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יַעְרָ֔ה וְיַעְרָ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־ עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מוֹצָֽא׃

passages.text: Moza was the father of Binea. Rephaiah was his son, Elasah his son, and Azel his son.
passages.sermon:
Moza was a man in Israel’s genealogy.
Moza had a son named Binea.
Binea had a son named Rephaiah.
Rephaiah had a son named Elasah.
Elasah had a son named Azel.
passages.original: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בִּנְעָ֑א וּרְפָיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
passages.sermon:
Azel was a man in Israel.
Azel had six sons.
Their names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
These six men were the sons of Azel.
passages.original: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֙כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃פ
